$comment: Plain YAML values that PyYAML (the server, YAML 1.1 with code-schema's number rule) and YAML 1.2 (the browser) read differently (M6.5 spec, M6CO.3). A plain key or value matching one is refused on both sides as CS1023: quote it. Each pattern is anchored and valid in Python's re and JavaScript's RegExp. Written once: the web's copy is generated by npm run figure-types.
